note: Committed from the Leon's Game Reviews app.

games.title: Ken Follett's The Pillars of the Earth
METAL GEAR SOLID V: THE PHANTOM PAIN
Mages of Mystralia
games.feelings: This game had a really unique spell combo system I wish more games would take inspiration from.  Good graphics too

games.title: Yonder: The Cloud Catcher Chronicles
games.feelings: love a game you can get physically lost in.  great collectibles, has all the things i like in a peaceful open world game.  Only problem is that i was you could get something thatd let you walk around faster or something like a speed boost.

games.title: Dragon Cliff
games.feelings: I apperently have 32 hours in this game.  Unmemmorable and unremarkable.

games.title: Hand Simulator
games.feelings: Inconsistent controls, terrible gameplay,  the gun glitched into the table and pulled the trigger.  Do not play this game. You cant eat pizza, and your arms can randomly disappear. All these bugs happened within 30 minutes of gameplay.

games.title: Gremlins vs Automatons
games.feelings: An actually decent board game.  I remember playing this alongside Civ 5 as a kid.

games.title: Turbo Dismount
games.feelings: Fun for like, 2 hours.  Might as well have been a flash game.

games.title: Antichamber
games.feelings: A very unique game.  It maximizes the way its non-Euclidean geometry makes the player feel, alongside those fun little messages it always delivers.

games.title: Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden
games.feelings: When i saw that the chances to hit were locked to incriments of 25%, I knew this game was too simple, at least coming from something like Xcom.

games.title: GemCraft - Chasing Shadows
games.feelings: One of the better tower defense games out there.  The gem combination gimick keeps things interesting for longer than i thought it would.

games.title: The Stanley Parable
games.feelings: A truly one-of-a-kind narrative game.  I genuinely cannot think of a comparable game.  The amount of cute secrets on top of the main game kept things interesting as well.

games.title: Passpartout: The Starving Artist
games.feelings: Cute and creative little drawing game.  Not much content tho.

games.title: XCOM 2
games.feelings: One of the top grid-based tactic games on the market.  Well balanced, and has mod support.

games.title: VA-11 Hall-A: Cyberpunk Bartender Action
games.feelings: This game still sticks with me.  I loved the characters in this game and with the simple drink-making mechanic, the characters is really all they had.  But I loved it all the same

games.title: Dave the Diver
games.feelings: This is a game I actually dropped initially and had to come back too.  Im glad I did, the gameplay loop is fun and the characters are enjoyable.

games.title: Dorfromantik
games.feelings: A continuous slog of "oh, well this piece will have to do".  You all to rarely get that happy moment of getting the perfect piece for what you need.  Its always just a make-do.

games.title: Viewfinder
games.feelings: A really novel concept executed fairly well.  A little short, which sucks because it was such a good time!  Needs a custom level editor.

games.title: Strange Horticulture
games.feelings: Great theming and atmosphere.  A little short, but the graphics and gameplay made for a nice experience.

games.title: Chessformer
games.feelings: Someone was like "What if chess themed puzzle game?" and here it is.  Nothing novel, but its a decent puzzle game.

games.title: Raft
games.feelings: One of those big streamer games, and for a good reason!  Nice base builder with fun islands to explore.  Great multiplayer too.

games.title: Backpack Hero
games.feelings: This game was a genre definer when it first game out.  The graphics werent much but the gameplay was really well made.  Im not a fan of how theyve done it now, its too much overtuned nonsense.  but in its peak, it was peak.

games.title: Neon White
games.feelings: I love these type of speedrun games.  This one comes with great gameplay, fun characters, just enough lore and story to match the gameplay.

games.title: Crayon Physics Deluxe
games.feelings: Unique concept for a puzzle game.  Short but sweet.

games.title: Tricky Towers
games.feelings: Love tetris.  Love puzzle games.  This is both.  Undefeated in multiplayer btw :D

games.title: Medieval Dynasty
games.feelings: An ok suvivor crafting game.  decent with friends.  Doesnt really explore anything new.

games.title: (the) Gnorp Apologue
games.feelings: A fantastic incrimental game!  Cute graphics and satisfying gameplay.

games.title: Soulstone Survivors
games.feelings: A decent survivor game.  Not very memorable.

games.title: Skala
games.feelings: Cute short little puzzle game

games.title: King of the Bridge
games.feelings: A GREAT parady chess game with cute graphics and funny puzzle elements, alongside multiple endings.  very well made

games.title: The Turing Test
games.feelings: A fun little puzzle game.  Good graphics and some pretty cool puzzle solving concepts.

games.title: Aces & Adventures
games.feelings: I enjoyed this game a lot more than I thought i would.  I enjoy how unique each character felt and the ways to build them were intuitive yet creative.

games.title: Tiny Rogues
games.feelings: A fun roguelike with a surprisingly robust upgrade system and character unlock.

games.title: The Talos Principle 2
games.feelings: They took a great game, gave it a fleshed out story, characters, and fantastic graphics.  Loved every moment of it.

games.title: The Talos Principle
games.feelings: I consider this game to be one of the great classic puzzle games, up there with Baba Is You and The Witness.  A must-play for any fan of the puzzle genre.  Great themings and atmosphere

games.title: Inscryption
games.feelings: A masterclass in theming, game design, and flavor.  Each act had its own structure, none fell short.  Act 1 is of course the main course that everyone fell in love with, but act 3 was my fan favorite.

games.title: Rabbit and Steel
games.feelings: Unique kind of game I hadnt seen before, executed pretty well.  No real problems with the game: cute graphics, fun with friends, can get good builds.  Enjoyed the time spent.

games.title: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library!
games.feelings: Idk what happened.  I dumped 17 hours into it in like 3 days.  Going for the no magic run had me in a trance.  I didnt even have something playing in the background.  My brain was 100% logistics.  It was a pretty cool experience

games.title: Crystal Project
games.feelings: With some games, the more you explore, the more of the world you explore.  With this game, the more you explore, the more you have to explore.

games.title: Patrick's Parabox
games.feelings: A well made puzzle game with a cute style and complicated yet intuitive puzzles.  Has custom workshop levels too!

games.title: Carto
games.feelings: A cute and simply puzzle game with enjoyable narrative and style.  A great little experience.

games.title: Disco Elysium
games.feelings: Disco Elysium is a well received game for a good reason.  The characters are great and the art style is wonderful.  The choices feel like they actually matter.

games.title: Ori and the Will of the Wisps
SpiderHeck
games.feelings: Fun solo and with friends.  Good movement tech, and the PvE is enjoyable.

games.title: Conqueror's Blade
games.feelings: "Warlord! Heres another pop-up to distract you mid-battle!"  Terrible UI, terrible tutorial.  Combat has its moments.

games.title: 9 Kings
games.feelings: It has fun combinations and enjoyable gameplay, but not enough variety.

games.title: Wildfrost
games.feelings: While the gameplay itself it fine, I feel that after the first few hours theres nothing to intriguing to it.  Each run doesnt feel that different and the exceptional runs are few and far between.  Still, nice graphics and gamefeel though.

games.title: Still Wakes the Deep
games.feelings: Really cool horror game.  The aspect of being trapped on an oil rig was a cool concept, and the graphics were great.  The gameplay was nice, non of the horror hurdles were too high.  The ending was ok.

games.title: Creatures of Ava
games.feelings: The graphics and gameplay were meh.  I do not believe I am the target audience for this game.

games.title: Tunic
games.feelings: A great experience.  A novel and unique concept executed very well.  I actually didnt get this game on my first playthrough, but after coming back to it Im glad I did.

games.title: PSychonauts 2
games.feelings: Psychonauts 1 with a new story and a new coat of paint.  They did well in this remake, keeping all the charm and gameplay of the first game.  A sequal done well methinks.

games.title: Psyconauts 1
games.feelings: Not a bad little game given it came out in 2005.  The gameplay holds up relatively well and the graphics arent that bad.

games.title: He is Coming
games.feelings: Overly simple combat, overly simple out of combat, limited item quantity limits the possibility for many cool item combinations.  This could have been a phone game.

games.title: Blue Prince
games.feelings: This is the greatest game I will ever drop.  Blue prince has incredible puzzle mechanics, exceptionally enjoyable runs, and a knack for keeping you pulled in.  Sadly where it falls short is late-game puzzles.  I am simply not smart enough to figure out many of the post blue-crown puzzles.  I wish there were more letters given to the player to help them along because boy did I need it.

games.title: Animal Well
games.feelings: A great metrodvania done very well.  Unique graphics, fun mechanics, cool post-game.  It was simply an enjoyable experience the whole time I was playing it.

games.title: Dredgers
games.feelings: Dredgers has a lot of cool things going on, and there is a chance I come back to it, but the game lacks a clear goal meaning every run is done for the sake of doing the run.  Once I had that golden run that got me through most the levels, I felt I had experienced most of what the game had to offer.

games.title: Luck be a Landlord
games.feelings: A great roguelike!  Nice simple graphics, cool concept executed well.  I feel the quality has deteriorated in the last few updates before it came out of early access, but given it was before Balatro, i think it did gamification really well.

games.title: Guilty as Sock
games.feelings: Fine as far as friendslop games go.  Gives you a good foundation to create funny moments.

games.title: Shattered Pixel Dungeon
games.feelings: It just, was NOT fun.  It seems theres some cool mechanics here but... Woof.  Just trying to get through the opening is a slog.

games.title: FACEMINER
games.feelings: A fun little incremental game with a cool theme.  Neat mechanics, but ultimately too short for my tastes.

games.title: Game Builder Tycoon
games.feelings: I tried playing this to feel what it was like to play Game Dev Tycoon, and it kinda worked, but this game just doesnt have the charm or balance.  No matter how well you do, it feels like youre always behind competitors and too late to do any big stuff before the end year hits.

games.title: Subnautica 2
games.feelings: Still in development, but so far its been a 9/10 for me.  Really good, especially with multiplayer!

games.title: Crypt Custodian
games.feelings: Better than I thought it would be!  Nothing special, very casual, but I enjoyed the ride while it lasted.  Did genuinely get tears out of me during the credits, but that was mostly due to my innate fear of death.  Would recommend!

games.title: runescape
games.feelings: Fun with friends!  Kind of tedius doing it solo

games.title: isles of sea and sky
games.feelings: great little puzzle game, but its starting to get too much.  Prob will watch a playthrough to see the ending

games.title: strange jigsaws
games.feelings: great follow up to 20 small mazes.  I got really sad when the goblin at the end said "ill miss you", because I knew id never see it again.

games.title: rain world
games.feelings: great game!  The difficulty and AI feel great!  Although trying to figure out the lore takes a LOT of travelling

games.title: Bots are stupid
games.feelings: not the best.  Hard to enjoy average coding games when Zachtronic coding games are so far above average.  Nothing in this game stood out enough to enjoy.

games.title: Ship Inc.
games.feelings: Seems like a game for girls.

games.title: DRG survivor
games.feelings: Fun gameplay, but very little reward incentive.  Just struggle then struggle.

games.title: miside
games.feelings: Wonderful horror / romance? Technically.  A little short, but the characters were great and I enjoyed every moment of it

games.title: Keep on mining
games.feelings: Great game!  Very casual, had plenty of unique upgrades.  Got a little grindy and the end, but I wish it was longer!

games.title: City Game Studio
games.feelings: Good game, but its EXTREMELY slow to gain fans?  Cant get to AAA before the end of the playable time limit

games.title: The drifter
games.feelings: Great game!  I haveant played a point n click adventure game this good since I played the Deponia trilogy. Its everything I hoped it would be: Great dialogue, great concept, great voice actors. It has a great ending that left me completely satisfied.

games.title: Our Adventuring guild
games.feelings: Fantastic RPG - it had everything I would want from an adventurer management game: fun mechanics, character interaction.  Every adventurer I recruited felt unique, which is hard to pull off.  I only wish there was more content and moddability.

games.title: Art of reflection
games.feelings: Great puzzle game, a little short, but enjoyable.

games.title: Dyson Sphere Progam
games.feelings: Just doesn’t do it for me like factorio does.  Modularity seems very difficult and input/ooutputs on machines is unclear.

games.title: Horizons Gate
games.feelings: Ill always remember this RPG.  Cool mechanics, memorable characters.

games.title: Rings of Saturn
games.feelings: This game has a cool atmosphere and game loop, but kind of lacks direction, and the more expensive ships don’t really feel like an upgrade.  Enjoyed the time I had with this though!

games.title: Tactical Breach Wizards
games.feelings: This game does everything perfectly, from level design and gameplay to out-of-combat character building.  It treats its player as intelligent and benefits for it.  A gold standard for video games.

games.title: Highfleet
games.feelings: Game has a nice aesthetic, but is lacking in many key parts.

games.title: The perfect tower 2.
games.feelings: a decent idle incrimental as any go.  Good mechanics, but it drones on at the end, and the ending didn’t account for me NOT having producers or dyson spheres, so I couldn’t even get any of the ending upgrades.  Still don’t regret playing though!

games.title: Eco
games.feelings: What a great concept for a game!  Only really fun with a group, but if you get a good group it can be a blast!

games.title: Portal 2
games.feelings: I consider this to be the best singleplayer game Valve has ever made.  Great story, gameplay, and memorable characters.

games.title: Portal 1
games.feelings: I ended up playing this after Portal 2, but even in Portal 1, you can see all the love and charm that laid the foundation to make Portal 2 even better

games.title: Dishonoured 1
games.feelings: The best stealth game.  Great mechanics, FANTASTIC characters and world building.  Although I have not played the assassings creed games, I cant imagine them being better than this

games.title: Dishonoured 2
games.feelings: People hate on 2 too much.  This game was a fantastic sequal, with cool new abilities and levels.  Graphics were gorgeos as well.

games.title: Half Life 1
games.feelings: Im sure this game was great for what it was back in the day, but It didn’t pull me in as much as I thought it would

games.title: Outer Wilds
games.feelings: Greatest Archeology game to date.  Some of the best gameplay and world building.  A gold standard for games

games.title: Outer Worlds
games.feelings: Not a bad game, but definitley forgettable.  I only ever think of this game when I think of Outer Wilds

games.title: Witness
games.feelings: Some people think this game is pretentious, but I find it to be a masterclass in world exploration puzzle gaming.

games.title: Baba is You
games.feelings: The best puzzle game hands down.  While other puzzle games such as Portal 2 and The Witness comes with  great characters or world to explore, Baba is You is pure puzzle, and it does it expertly.

games.title: Prey
games.feelings: While this game featured a great world, cool enemies, and fun weapons, I found most of the story and characters to be forgettable.

games.title: Just Cause 2
games.feelings: Fun gameplay and world!  But that’s about it.

games.title: Maize
games.feelings: What a weird game.  Neat, but weird

games.title: Doki Doki Literature club
games.feelings: Classic.  Short, but good.  Yuri best girl

games.title: Fallout new Vegas
games.feelings: One of the best fallout games.  Memmoreable character, world and story.

games.title: Fallout 3
games.feelings: While the gameplay is nice, I cant really remember much of the story or characters.

games.title: Fallout 4
games.feelings: I loved this game.  The characters were cool, I liked the story and it has Nick Valentine.

games.title: Skyrim
games.feelings: It was the golden era of video games, and one of the greatest open world games of the decade dropped.  Skyrim is Skyrim.  I pray they do not screw up ES6.

games.title: Scanner Sombre
games.feelings: Cool concept for a horror game, and great story.  A little short, and the horror aspects need some work, but overall great.

games.title: Wuppo
games.feelings: Fantastic little 2d adventure!  Fun gameplay

games.title: Osiris New Dawn
games.feelings: Really cool giant worms, but that’s about it.

games.title: Event[0]
games.feelings: While I don’t remember much, I do remember the mascot and having a generally enjoyable experience

games.title: Borderlands
games.feelings: While im sure the gameplay was fine… I just don’t remember a dang thing about the game

games.title: Borderlands 2
games.feelings: Now this game is great!  Great gameplay, absolutley on the list for one of the top game villians.

games.title: Borderlands pre-sequal
games.feelings: People give this game too much hate.  It wasn’t the best, but I had fun with it.

games.title: Borderlands 3
games.feelings: Had some cool gameplay moments, but not memmorable

games.title: Tales from the borderlands
games.feelings: Best telltale game.  Great characters, cool story concepts.  Enjoyable the whole way through.

games.title: Norwoord suite
games.feelings: Played this game because it was published by the Yogscast, and I don’t regret it.  Short, weird, but cool.

games.title: What remains of Edith Finch
games.feelings: Short, but great.  Cool concepts, memmorable moments.

games.title: The Unfinished Swan
games.feelings: Another short but sweet game, love games like this.

games.title: Superhot
games.feelings: Cool and unique gameplay

games.title: Superhot VR
games.feelings: One of the best VR games.  Play this to feel like a cool anime character

games.title: Superhot MCD
games.feelings: More of the great gameplay of superhot

games.title: Creeper world 4
games.feelings: Great tower defense game, with plents of content.  Looking at the other creeper world games, id say 3d looks a lot cooler than the 2d games

games.title: Opus Magnum
games.feelings: Another classic out of the legendary Zachtronics.  He took his fun instruction based puzzles and gave it a wonderful world and characters to go along with it.  A must-play for any Zachtronic fan.

games.title: Exapunks
games.feelings: I have a great love for this game.  It comes with an instruction manual it encourages you to print yourself and I assure you I spend however much money in ink to do so.  More coding based that most Zachtronic games, but still comes with that charming world building and character dialogue youd expect from Zach

games.title: Infinifactory
games.feelings: The only 3d Zachtronic game, the first Zachtronic game id had ever played, and Ironically my least favorite.  While the puzzle elements and world building are fine, theyre just not the diamonds one would expect from a Zachtronic title.  That’s not to say its bad by any means, im merely comparing a delicious chicken sanwhich to what is normally a fine filet-mignon.  Absolutely sill worth playing!

games.title: Secrets of Grindea
games.feelings: One of the best indie adventure games Ive ever played.  Good  combat, cool world, cool characters, great progression.  I had fun the whole time playing it.

games.title: FTL: Faster Than Light
games.feelings: This game is the best roguelike made.  With over 500 hours played thanks to modding, Ill be continueing to play this for a long time.  Im  a sucker for any game that lets you pause and think.

games.title: Into the breach
games.feelings: By the same creators as FTL, into the breach is a gem of a strategy game.  Great mechanics, similar to Tactical Breach Wizards.

games.title: Dream Tactics
games.feelings: This game surprised me with how good it was.  This is one of the few games that had such INCREDIBLE loot for exploring and doing side missions.  Every time I got a new set of cards or artifact it would completely reshape the way my next battle would go.  This led to a VERY good motivation to explore and play, resulting in a LOT of fun.  Characters and world were good too!

games.title: There is No Game: Wrong Direction
games.feelings: A cute point and click game going through a few genres and poking fun at them.  A little short, but a novel experience none-theless

games.title: Renowned Explorers: International Society
games.feelings: Inside was a crazy ride of a game.  One of the coolest atmospheres and world youll see in a game.  Ending was strange, but fitting.

games.title: Mushroom 11
games.feelings: Cool game mechanic and all, but utilized poorly methinks

games.title: Beholder
games.feelings: Mid game with even more mid sequals.  Great game if youre a peeping time kinda guy

games.title: Gigachess
games.feelings: I like chess, but not this.  Simply was not fun enough to continue

games.title: Pony Island
games.feelings: Underwhelming coming from the same Daniel Mullins who designed the masterpiece that is Inscryption.  it was his first game however, so hopefully it is redeemed in pony island 2

games.title: Brothers - A Tale of Two Sons
BattleBlock Theatre
games.feelings: Just not my type of game

games.title: Lego Jurassic world
games.feelings: I love the lego series!  This ones not very memmorable though

games.title: Trucking simulator 2
games.feelings: Nice to play with something in the background

games.title: Card Hunter
games.feelings: This used to be a great game to play in school on browser.  May revisit some day!

games.title: Broken Age
games.feelings: A great point and click adventure game with a cool world and nice characters.  Has a place in my heart.  Small, but a place.

games.title: Big Pharma
games.feelings: The problem with most factory games is that most of the time, id rather just be playing Factorio

games.title: Civ V
games.feelings: Civ 5 was a marvel of a turn based strategy game, and many consider this one to be the best in the series.  Many enjoyable hours have been has in this game.

games.title: Zup
games.feelings: It’s a simple puzzle game.  That’s it.

games.title: Blueprint Tycoon
games.feelings: This is what you played to try to fill the Prison Architect niche.  It didn’t work.

games.title: Adventure Communist
games.feelings: What if we made Adventure Capitalist, but worse in every way?

games.title: Grow Up
games.feelings: A fun game about growin a plant.  Good gameplay, but that’s kind of it.

games.title: Reprisal Universe
games.feelings: Not a bad game, it just failed to keep me pulled in

games.title: Hammerwatch
games.feelings: Its ok with friends, but it doesn’t do anytthing special

games.title: Holy Potatoes! A Weapon Shop?!
games.feelings: This game had fine mechanics, and a cute charm, but did little else.

games.title: Hand of Fate
games.feelings: A card game with real time combat?  Not my style.

games.title: Slots & Daggers
games.feelings: This game knows how to gamify the experience, but not balance.  Most weapons and upgrades were completely worthless, and the game was too short.  Not a bad little experience though.

games.title: Berry Bury Berry
games.feelings: Gameplay can get a little repetitive mid-game, but overall was enjoyable.  Good ending too.

games.title: There is no Cave
games.feelings: Controls felt clunks and speedrunning most levels were about getting perfect grapple angles, which wasn’t very fun.  Cool aethetic tho

games.title: Linelith
games.feelings: Oh the hopes to play more The Witness.  Cute little puzzle game, with good mechanics.  Too short to warrant a higher rating

games.title: Calvins Gallery
games.feelings: Played this on a whim after hearing nice things about it online.  I hate RPGMK games.  They all suck and have no soul put into them.

games.title: Leap year
games.feelings: A rule discovery game with plenty of fun and unique mechanics!  A little short, but very enjoyable.

games.title: Handshakes
games.feelings: Neat little showcase of a fun puzzle game

games.title: The magic circle
games.feelings: I remember thinking this was the COOLEST game because of how clever the modular enemies were.  Nice story too.

games.title: Mad Max
games.feelings: I have very few memories of this game despite having 34 hours in it.  I remember decent graphics and ok gameplay.

games.title: Hook
games.feelings: Theres a whole slough of "simplistic puzzle game you can beat in like 5 hours".  This is one of them

games.title: Farming Simulator 2013
games.feelings: Genuinley do not know the difference between any of these games.  I think they add grass mowing at some point?

games.title: Farming Simulator 2015
games.feelings: Genuinley do not know the difference between any of these games.  I think they add grass mowing at some point?

games.title: Farming Simulator 2017
games.feelings: Genuinley do not know the difference between any of these games.  I think they add grass mowing at some point?

games.title: Farming Simulator 2019
games.feelings: Genuinley do not know the difference between any of these games.  I think they add grass mowing at some point?
